title: 第11章 书中悟法第12章 全凭努力
content_zh:
风铃轻响，胡教习那裹挟着淡淡墨香的身影踏入听雨轩。
原本还在低声私语的二十余名内舍学子，如同被一只无形的大手按住了咽喉，瞬间噤声。
正襟危坐，目不斜视，仿佛刚才的闲谈从未发生过。
胡教习径直走到讲台后的蒲团上坐下。
但他并没有像往常那样直接翻开书卷，也没有如在大课上那般展现出“时不我待”的紧迫感。
他只是端起案几上的紫砂茶壶，慢条斯理地斟了一杯茶，轻轻吹去浮沫，浅啜一口。
时间一点点流逝。
茶香在静谧的水榭中氤氲开来。
轩内众人的目光，开始若有若无地飘向讲台左手边那个空置的蒲团。
那蒲团比旁的略大一圈，色泽深沉，摆放的位置更是紧挨着胡教习，仿佛那个位置的主人拥有着某种特殊的特权。
“既然人未到齐，那便等等吧。”
胡教习放下茶盏，语气平淡，没有半分不悦，仿佛等待是理所应当之事。
苏秦微微一怔。
他在一级院待了三年，印象中的胡教习可是出了名的严苛古板
哪怕是迟到半息都会被罚站在门外听课，何时变得如此宽容？
甚至……有些近乎纵容？
“胡教习一向如此……和蔼？”
苏秦微微侧头，压低声音问道。
身旁的徐子训轻笑一声，眼神中带着几分玩味
“和蔼？苏兄莫要被表象骗了。这老头若是到了大课上，那就是个活阎王。但在听雨轩……”

他指了指那个空位，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的弧度
“他等的不是人，是人才。”
“那个位置，是留给林清寒的。”
“刚入门两个月，便已聚元大圆满。
不仅如此，她在藏经阁中仅用半月，便悟出了《松土》、《肥地》、《除草》等八门辅助法术，且皆已修至二级。”
“八门……皆二级？”
苏秦心中微震。
常人修一门法术至二级，往往需数月乃至数年水磨工夫。
这林清寒不仅修得快，而且修得杂，这等悟性，确实堪称妖孽。
“这便是差距啊。”
徐子训叹了口气，却没什么嫉妒之意，只是单纯的陈述事实
“她是这期二级院考核中，胡教习麾下最有希望冲击全府前十的种子。
对于这种能给教习长脸、甚至能给整个班里带来气运加持的天才，别说是等一刻钟，就是等上一天，胡老头也乐意。”
苏秦了然地点了点头。
大周仙朝，修仙亦是科举。
既然是科举，那便是唯成绩论。
content_en:
The wind chimes rang softly, and Mr. Hu's figure, wrapped in the faint fragrance of ink, stepped into Tingyuxuan.
The twenty or so students in the inner house who were still whispering in low voices were silenced instantly as if their throats were pressed by a big invisible hand.
Sitting upright and looking straight, it was as if the chat just now had never happened.
Hu Jiaoxi walked straight to the futon behind the podium and sat down.
But he did not open the book directly as usual, nor did he show the sense of urgency that "the time has not waited for us" as he did in the big class.
He just picked up the purple clay teapot on the desk, poured a cup of tea slowly, blew away the foam, and took a sip.
Time passes little by little.
The aroma of tea lingers in the quiet waterside pavilion.
The eyes of everyone in the hall began to drift towards the empty futon on the left side of the podium.
The futon was slightly larger than the one next to it, with a darker color. It was placed right next to Professor Hu, as if the owner of that position had some special privileges.
"Since everyone is not here yet, let's wait."
Hu Jiaoxi put down the tea cup, his tone was calm, without any displeasure, as if waiting was a matter of course.
Su Qin was slightly startled.
He stayed in the first-level hospital for three years, and the impression he had of Professor Hu was that he was famous for being strict and old-fashioned.
Even if you are half-breath late, you will be punished by standing outside the door to listen to the class. When did you become so tolerant?
Even...somewhat almost indulgent?
"Hu Jiaoxi has always been so...kind?"
Su Qin tilted his head slightly and asked in a lowered voice.
Xu Zixun beside him chuckled, with a bit of amusement in his eyes.
"Amiable? Brother Su, don't be deceived by appearances. If this old man reaches the big class, he will be a living king of hell. But listening to Yuxuan..."
He pointed at the empty seat and raised a meaningful arc at the corner of his mouth.
"What he is waiting for is not people, but talents."
"That position is reserved for Lin Qinghan."
“Just two months after I started practicing, I have already reached the Great Perfection.
Not only that, she spent only half a month in the Sutra Pavilion to master eight auxiliary spells including "Loose Soil", "Fertile Land", and "Weeding", and she had already mastered all of them to the second level. "
"Eight gates... are all Level 2?"
Su Qin's heart was slightly shaken.
It often takes months or even years for ordinary people to practice a magic to reach the second level.
This Lin Qinghan not only cultivated quickly, but also practiced comprehensively. With such understanding, he could indeed be called a monster.
"This is the gap."
Xu Zixun sighed, but he didn't mean to be jealous, he just stated the facts.
"She is the most promising seed under Hu Jiaoxi to break into the top ten in this second-level college assessment.
For this kind of genius who can make his teachers look good and even bring luck to the whole class, Old Man Hu is happy to wait for a whole day, let alone a quarter of an hour. "
Su Qin nodded understandingly.
In the Immortal Dynasty of the Great Zhou Dynasty, cultivating immortals was also an imperial examination.
Since it is an imperial examination, it is based on merit alone.
